Class SimpleContext

java.lang.Object
dev.faststats.SimpleContext
All Implemented Interfaces:
FastStatsContext
public final class SimpleContext extends Object implements FastStatsContext
The FastStats context implementation shared by all platforms.

Platforms do not extend this class. Instead, they configure a SimpleContext.Builder with their platform-specific pieces, such as the logger, configuration, scheduler and default metrics data, and expose their own factory on top of it.

Since:
0.24.0

    • startSubmission

      @Internal public void startSubmission()
      Starts submitting data to FastStats.

      Platforms call this once submission is allowed, for example when the context is ready and the first run onboarding or consent screen is done. Does nothing if the context is disabled or submission is already active.

      If a submission task cannot be scheduled, every task scheduled so far is canceled, submission stays inactive and the failure is rethrown, so it can be started again later.

      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if the platform scheduler rejected a submission task
      Since:
      0.33.0

    • stopSubmission

      @Internal public void stopSubmission()
      Stops submitting data to FastStats without flushing pending data.

      Submission can be started again with startSubmission().

      Since:
      0.33.0

    • updateConfig

      @Internal @Contract(mutates="this") public void updateConfig(Config config) throws IllegalArgumentException
      Replaces the configuration of this context, for example after the user changed their consent.

      Services read the configuration on every submission, so the change applies to the next one. Submission is not started or stopped by this method, see startSubmission() and stopSubmission().

      Parameters:
      config - the new configuration
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the server id differs from the current configuration
      Since:
      0.33.0

    • readToken

      @Contract(mutates="io") public static @Nullable String readToken(ClassLoader loader, String id)
      Reads a token that was injected at build time from the "META-INF/faststats/" directory.

      The token is read from the resource META-INF/faststats/<id>.token using the given class loader. Surrounding whitespace is ignored.

      The resource is namespaced by id because some platforms load every project from a shared class loader.

      If the resource is missing, empty, unreadable or does not contain a valid token (for example an unresolved build placeholder such as ${faststats.token}), null is returned. Passing null to the context creates a disabled context, so builds without a token (such as forks) keep working without submitting any data.

      Parameters:
      loader - the class loader used to find the resource, usually the project's class loader
      id - the project identifier, such as the plugin name or mod id
      Returns:
      the token, or null if no token was injected
      Since:
      0.32.0
